description: Consumer rule for an unknown format id (plugin-protocol.md section 5.5.1). BinaryFormat is marked x-slopvac-extensible, so a later host may send an id that an older plugin does not know. The plugin declines that document with extract-unsupported (-32008) and answers the others; it does not fail the request with invalid-params. The host then handles d2 as an input that no enabled extractor reads, so that run exits 2; this vector checks the plugin side only. A strict schema check of the request reports an error only at unknown_format_pointer, the extensible position. Manifest validation stays strict: a manifest that declares the same id is refused at manifest_pointer.
